integrity: Exact proof and source-level reproducible checker included. Prior finite-abelian-difference-set result already covers the sharp constant on each four-point arm, but not the seven-point union.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the quartic graph over the seven-element field; global inequality for every complex coefficient, no extension to other fields. Historical priority assessed only through the recorded accessible sources. Mathematical proof is algebraic; finite checks corroborate without certifying generalization.
title: Sharp unrestricted fourth-moment extension on the seven-point quartic graph
